card.name: Quantity in parentheses after a dose
card.fires_on: The number or count word (2, two, one) right after an opening parenthesis that follows a dose in mg. It gives the amount of tablets, capsules or mL that makes up that dose.

modes.label: Volume or count in brackets
modes.description: A digit or number word opens a parenthesis after a mg dose, giving mL or the number of tablets.
modes.example: the dosage of BRYNOVIN is 50 mg (<<2>> mL) once daily

modes.label: Number word for units
modes.description: A spelled-out number or 'one' gives the number of tablets or capsules making up the dose.
modes.example: increase to the recommended dosage of 274 mg (<<two>> 137 mg capsules) once

modes.label: Per or one before a unit
modes.description: A linking word like per or one before packet, unit or teaspoon in a dose statement.
modes.example: VIJOICE Oral Granules (50 mg<< per>> packet)

card.writes: It pushes toward the word brush and away from the word action, which looks unrelated to the pattern.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dose line where the label says how many tablets or how many mL make up the dose.
